paragraphs: All the Tannaim and Amoraim whose father's name was Yosef.
Rav Acha bar Yosef, Shabbat 110b, or the son of Rav Yosef, Eruvin 29b.
Rav Hamnuna son of Rav Yosef, Berakhot 24b.
Rav Chana bar Yosef, Taanit ch. 4, end of halakhah 5.
Rav Chama bar Yosef, Shabbat 7b, or the son of Rav Yosef, Eruvin 65b, according to the reading of Dikdukei Soferim.
Rabbi Yonatan (or Natan) bar Yosef, Berakhot 29b.
Rav Yitzchak bar Yosef, Berakhot 9b. Mar son of Rav Yosef, Shabbat 115b.
Rav Nechemya son of Rav Yosef, Shabbat 3b. Sumchos bar Yosef, the well-known.
Rav Anan bar Yosef, Midrash Tehillim, ch. 65, section 4.
Rabbi Akiva bar Yosef, the well-known.
Rav Papa son of Rav Yosef, Bava Metzia 113b. Rabbah bar Yosef, Arakhin 5b.

notes.text: This notice lists people by their father-name Yosef; it does not identify all those fathers with one another. The source prints Midrash Tehillim65:4.
An earlier editorial comparison proposed chapter68 for the Midrash Tehillim reference; the supplied notice gives65:4, which is retained here.

Berakhot 45b directly names Rav Dimi bar Yosef. This corroborates that listed patronymic, not a single shared father for all the people in the index. The consulted Berakhot 24b passage gives the shorter Hamnuna without the patronymic; it does not independently verify the supplied Hamnuna bar Yosef form.
